title: J_c — Cognitive 5-tuple (q_speace_economy §4.2)
description: Structured measurement tuple (J, ΔS, ΔI_c, R_b, ΔC) used to evaluate the cognitive contribution of an action. None of the components is a consciousness claim; all are independently measurable physical quantities.

J.description: Total useful exergy produced or conserved by the action, in joules.

delta_S.description: Entropy produced (>=0) or destroyed (<=0) by the action, in joules per kelvin.

delta_I_c.description: Change in catalytic information content (Kolmogorov-style structural complexity), in bits.

R_b.description: Regenerative budget remaining after the action, dimensionless in [0,1].

delta_C.description: Net change in catalytic capacity (positive = capacity gained, negative = dissipated), dimensionless.

confidence.description: Measurement confidence in [0,1]; reflects telemetry completeness, not subjective belief.

metadata.description: Free-form annotations: agent id, source, timestamp, units override.
